description: Legacy Brevo JavaScript tracker on sibautomation.com/sa.js, whose client key rides as key. The V2 loader on cdn.brevo.com/js/sdk-loader.js has no key on the URL and is not contracted. REST events are vendor/brevo.

params.name: key
params.description: It is the tracker `client_key`. The published JS snippet loads `sa.js?key=` plus that value.
params.fix_hint: Copy the tracker snippet from Automation settings so `key` carries the client key.
